title.label: Product Title
title.notes: Varies by category (many categories cap at 200 chars); avoid promotional phrases and ALL CAPS.

bullets.label: Bullet Points
bullets.notes: Up to 5 benefit-led bullets; start each with a concise feature phrase.

description.label: Product Description
description.notes: Clear, scannable copy; no HTML scripts or external URLs.

search_terms.label: Backend Search Terms
search_terms.notes: Byte-counted limit (UTF-8 <= 250 bytes); space-separated, no commas or brand names.

style_notes: Title Case, numerals for numbers, Brand + Model + Key Feature + Material + Size + Quantity. Never use promotional text or symbols like ! or *.
